card.name: Words leading into disease names
card.fires_on: Linking words and word pieces just before a disease or illness is named, such as 'can' or 'also' before an infection, or the 'ch' in bronchitis. It appears in general text about infections and ill health.

modes.description: A verb or connector that leads into a named disease or health problem.
